next_step: Finalize PoC plan, start Hosted API pilot, share pricing for Dedicated baseline
notes: Background: mid-market SaaS that powers in-app search, support chat, and automated summarization for product teams.
Current stack: prototypes built on OpenAI API + internal prompt service. Want to reduce unit cost and add dedicated capacity; experimenting with migration strategy to Redwood Hosted then Dedicated.
Key ask: compatibility layer so existing prompts + tool-calling keep parity; low regression risk for high-value customer flows (billing summaries, compliance snippets).
Performance targets: 95th perc latency <= 250ms for 256-token chat, sustained throughput ~60 reqs/sec for embeddings/reranking during peak hours; burst to 200 reqs/sec.
Cost sensitivity: tight — current infra spend is 18% of ARR; procurement wants predictable committed pricing and autoscale guardrails to avoid runaway costs.
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) mandatory, audit logs must be retained 1 year, support for customer-managed KMS for encryption in transit/at-rest is preferred, data residency EU for EU customers.

PoC plan agreed (high level): 2-week Hosted API pilot with subset of traffic (support chat), run parallel to OpenAI, capture regression rate on intent extraction and hallucination metrics, then evaluation week for Dedicated sizing + pricing.
Notes from 2026-03-05 call: customer 'wants near-zero drift' when switching providers — quoted product lead. Concern about stop-sequence handling and streaming chunking differences.

Engineering feedback (internal): need a mapping table for temperature/penalty differences, tokenizer token accounting differences caused ~8% avg token delta during tests. SE recommended Redwood Optimize suggestions for burst batching and prefix caching.
Security review: initial SSO SAML flow passed internal checklist; legal asked for SOC2 report and data residency SLA. Redwood security FAQ link provided; awaiting KMS integration docs.
Pricing convo: requested a baseline Dedicated quote based on 4x A100-equivalent reserve with burst to shared capacity. Finance wants a 12-month commit option and a usage+commit blended model.
POC success criteria (customer): 1) Prompt parity: <= 3% semantic regression on top-20 intents; 2) Latency SLOs met; 3) Token cost reduction >= 20% vs current provider under similar quality settings.
Recent activities:
- 2026-02-19: Intro demo with Maya (AE) + Raj (SE). Walkthrough of Hosted API and migration playbook.
- 2026-02-25: Security checklist submitted; legal asked for SOC2 + encryption details (drive link shared).
- 2026-03-05: Fireflies call — deep dive on prompt parity, tokenizer diffs, streaming expectations. Action: engineering to run side-by-side prompt tokens test.
- 2026-03-09: SE ran 5000-sample regression run vs OpenAI baseline — initial drift 4.6% on intent match; working on tokenization normalization and temp/scaling adjustments.
- 2026-03-11: Pricing sync with finance; Redwood offered provisional Dedicated pricing tier (see drive doc). Customer requested formal quote and payment terms.
Open items / asks to push forward:
- Provide a short compatibility guide: API mapping, common prompt idioms, recommended stop/stream config.
- Run one more regression with token-normalization script (SE to deliver by 2026-03-15).
- Provide Dedicated sizing worksheet and firm 12-month commit price by next week.
Decision influencer: CTO (focus: cost predictability, SLOs), Head of Product (focus: prompt parity and UX), Finance (Procurement).
Next steps (owner map): Maya to deliver pricing, Raj to run final regression, Arielle to collect security signoff docs, product team to schedule pilot cutover window.
Quote from product lead on call: 'We need a migration path that doesn't break our support SLAs — can't afford regressions in summarization or entity extraction.'
Potential risks: tokenization mismatch causing billing delta, edge-case hallucinations on billing text, legal hold on EU customer data delaying Dedicated deployment.
If PoC meets criteria -> roadmap: Hosted pilot (2 wks) -> Dedicated reserved capacity (Q3 deploy) -> Optional on-prem/air-gapped for gov customers later.
